referenceFunction.generalComment: Calculation for transport distances assuming transport by pipeline offshore and onshore as well as sea transport in tanker. Sites and modes of transportation based on the supply situation in 2023. UUID=3bd7d8a7-b0da-339e-b6cb-0b6751b38ba4
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transportation of crude oil from exploration sites to refineries in CA-region. Includes transport service requirements and emissions from oil handling and evaporation.

geography.text: Calculations include production and transport of crude oil from 13 countries.

technology.text: Operation of crude oil pipelines by electricity.

representativeness.productionVolume: 94.8 million tons of directly imported crude oil to CA region in 2023.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Literature. Online calculators for distances. The consumption mix is calculated based on international trade statistics for 2023.
